notes: app 1.11.3 -> 1.11.7, chart 0.10.0 unchanged. App: an org admin can now pick the appliance generative model from the settings, and the app seeds and reconciles a transcription model row (AIModel with supportsTranscription) as the org default, while never offering or picking a transcription row as a chat model. Deploy: the qwen27b profile serves Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on a third vLLM behind the same proxy (/v1/audio/* to vllm-stt, about 10 GiB resident), compose and STT_PORT default sanely on a .env written before transcription existed, and switch-model.sh keeps the generative rename off the transcription row. A profile with no transcription leaves VLLM_MODEL_TRANSCRIPTION empty and the app says no transcription model is configured instead of calling a route nothing serves.
